Alright, please stay here.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
好的，請留在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Do you know who she was?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你知道她是誰嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Yes, she's one of the senior researchers, her name is ^0000CDElyumina.^000000
scripts.translation:
[工人]
是的，她是高階研究員，叫^0000CDElyumina^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
It was stupid thing to come and attack directly. What are they studying?
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
直接衝進來襲擊他們，真夠蠢的。他們到底在研究什麼？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
That's because I'm the only mechanic in the lab. I don't care about anything other than my own machines...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
因為我是實驗室裡唯一的機械師。我只關心自己的機器...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Now that I think about it, her eyes were not normal. She looks like a crazy person.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
現在想想，她的眼神確實不正常，簡直像個瘋子。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Have you ever seen her room? I was frightened when I saw it the first time. She closed the door quickly, but I saw it.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你見過她的房間嗎？我第一次看到時嚇壞了。她很快就把門關上了，不過我還是看見了裡面。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Are you saying you've witnessed an illegal experiment?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你是說，你目擊了非法實驗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Yeah, maybe it was. These machines moved strangely. Huh...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
嗯...也許真是非法實驗。那些機器動得很奇怪...

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Do you trust what we've been saying now?
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
現在你相信我們說的話了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Yes, I believe you! I absolutely believe you now!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
是的，我相信你們！我現在完全相信你們了！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
If it's not the vice president, who else would we trust!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
如果不是副總裁，我們還能相信誰呢！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Good. We can continue with our investigation now. Vice President, please give me the documents.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
好，那我們可以繼續調查了。副總裁，把檔案給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
What documents?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
什麼檔案？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The list of missing people. I need to double check with who we have here.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
失蹤人員名單。我得和這裡的人核對一下。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Here, stand in line please. Make three rows. Please tell me your full name when your turn comes.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
請大家排好隊，分成三列。輪到你時，告訴我全名。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Vice President, a moment... I have something to report
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
副總裁，請等一下...我有事要報告。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
What's the matter?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
It's not something I can tell you here, so please come over <NAVI>[here]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
這裡不方便說，請跟我來<NAVI>[這裡]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
Didn't you see <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> going with the Vice President? I'm worried about the wounded people.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
你沒看到<NAVI>[阿斯]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>跟副總裁一起走了嗎？我得照看傷員。

scripts.text:
[Tes]
It will take some time to finish the investigation and gather all the data here.
scripts.translation:
[泰斯]
完成這裡的調查並收集所有資料還需要一些時間。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
This place is very dangerous. Come back when you're strong enough to protect your own body.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
這裡很危險。等你有能力保護自己後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I hope we can find all the missing people here. I really do.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我希望我們能找到這裡所有的失蹤者。我是真心的。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
It looks like <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is concerned about the injured. Let's go see what she wants to talk about.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
看起來<NAVI>[阿斯]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>很擔心傷員。我們去看看她有什麼事。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Adventurer. Could I speak with you for a moment please?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
冒險者。能佔用你一點時間嗎？

scripts.text: What's the matter?
scripts.translation: 怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
You and others previously attacked a lab that's been conducting illegal experiments.
What do you think about this one?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
你和同伴之前襲擊過一個進行非法實驗的實驗室。你覺得這裡也是一樣嗎？

scripts.text: I think this lab is the same.
scripts.translation: 我覺得這裡也是同樣的情況。

scripts.text: I don't know
scripts.translation: 我不知道

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I think this lab has also been doing illegal experiments. So... could I ask you a favor?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我認為這裡也在進行非法實驗。所以...能拜託你一件事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I think this is the laboratory where the ^0000FFmissing people were sent to.^000000 Besides the people in this area, there might be other that we can't see right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我認為這裡就是^0000FF失蹤人員被送來的地方。^000000除了眼前這些人，可能還有其他失蹤者被關在我們看不到的地方。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I would like you to ^0000FFcontinue investigating Patrick Kaufmann's case.^000000
If he worked here, the others might people here know something about him.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我希望你能^0000FF繼續調查帕特里克·考夫曼的下落。^000000
如果他曾在這裡工作，其他人或許知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Maybe... this is the last chance we'll have to find Patrick after all.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
也許...這真的是我們找到帕特里克的最後機會了。

scripts.text: I'll look into it.
scripts.translation: 我會去查的。

scripts.text: I have something else to do right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在有別的事要忙。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
It's okay, you don't have to look right now. There are other urgent matters to take care of.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
沒關係，你不用現在就去。還有更緊急的事要處理。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
But please think of Kaufmann when you can.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
但請你在方便的時候想想考夫曼的事。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Thank you. I'm sorry to have had to ask you this so suddenly.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
謝謝。很抱歉這麼突然地向你提出這個請求。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I would like you to continue investigating Patrick Kaufmann.
Maybe if he worked here, the others might know something about it.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
請繼續調查帕特里克·考夫曼的下落。
如果他曾在這裡工作，其他人或許知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Oh, welcome back adventurer. Come. Kaufmann, did you find him?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
哦，歡迎回來，冒險者。過來吧。找到考夫曼了嗎？

scripts.text: I have... this bracelet.
scripts.translation: 我找到了...這個手鐲。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Those are...? What is that?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
那是...？那是什麼？

scripts.text: This is an identification bracelet.
scripts.translation: 這是身份識別手鐲。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
This is Kaufmann's...? Were there other people there?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
這是考夫曼的...？那裡還有其他人在嗎？

scripts.text: - I told Kaya the story about the researcher you met at Rudus and about the experiments. -
scripts.translation: - 你向卡雅講述了在魯德斯遇見的研究員，以及那些實驗。 -

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Why didn't the researcher come back with you?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
為什麼那個研究員沒有和你一起回來？

scripts.text: She didn't want to come back...
scripts.translation: 她不想回來...

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I see...
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Alright. Later, I will send a specialist to look for a body or remains. Again, Your services must be properly rewarded.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
好。稍後我會派專家去尋找遺體或遺骸。你的幫助理應得到報酬。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
If you have the time, I hope you will give these experiments a proper rest. There is no one other than you... the adventurer, to see them through.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
如果你有空，希望你能讓這些實驗受害者安息。能完成這件事的，只有你這位冒險者了。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I'm sorry to keep asking these hard task for you. If you can bring me their bracelets, I will reward you.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
總是讓你做這麼棘手的事，真抱歉。若能帶回他們的手鐲，我會給你報酬。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I will go back to the headquarters with the list of missing people. I'll use the bracelets as evidence and send the necessary compensation to their families.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我會帶著失蹤人員名單返回總部，用這些手鐲作為證據，並向他們的家屬支付應有的補償。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
All future work will be handled through ^0000FFAas over here^000000. I will hand the bracelets to Aas.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
接下來的工作由這裡的^0000FF阿斯^000000負責。我會把手鐲交給她。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Thank you for everything you have done so far.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
感謝您迄今為止所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I would like you to continue investigating Patrick Kaufmann.
Maybe if he worked here, the others might know something about it.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我希望你能繼續調查帕特里克·考夫曼。
也許如果他曾在這裡工作，其他人可能知道一些情況。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
It looks like <NAVI>[Aas]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> is concerned about the wounded people. Let's hear what she wants to talk about.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
看起來<NAVI>[阿斯]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>很擔心傷員。我們去聽聽她要說什麼。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
We don't know when there will be an enemy attack. Come back when you can protect yourself.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我們不知道敵人什麼時候會發動攻擊。
等你能夠保護自己時再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Ashley]
I honestly had no idea this place was hidden here. How the hell did they manage to avoid the surrounding people's attention?
scripts.translation:
[阿什莉]
我真沒想到這裡竟然藏著這樣一個地方。他們到底怎麼瞞過附近的人，把這裡藏起來的？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
This way.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
這邊請。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
What's the status of the wounded people?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
傷員的情況怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
They're being looked at seriously, but we're also getting some paperwork done about them.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
他們正在接受治療，我們也在為他們辦理相關手續。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
As we started treating them, we've found some ^0000FFserious health issues^000000 in addition to their injuries.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
開始治療後，我們發現他們除了傷勢之外，還有^0000FF嚴重的健康問題^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Tell me more.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
詳細說說。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
It seems they were ^0000FFpoisoned^000000 while moving waste materials and their clothes were contaminated by various dangerous substances used in the lab because they didn't have safety equipment.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
他們搬運廢料時似乎^0000FF中了毒^000000。由於沒有安全裝備，衣服也沾上了實驗室使用的各種危險物質。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
She didn't even follow basic safety rules. How many have been poisoned?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
她連最基本的安全規程都不遵守。到底有多少人中毒？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Yes, only the people resting over there...
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
是的，只有那邊休息的人...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Am I... dead?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我...死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Oh! The reporting site wasn't looking too good!
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
情況不太妙！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
But, when I die... what about my family... my family...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
可是...我死了的話，我的家人怎麼辦...我的家人...

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Don't worry, you won't die.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
別擔心，你不會死的。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Didn't you say we were about to die?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你剛才不是說我們快死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I said your bodies weren't healthy, but who said anything about dying?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我只是說你們的身體狀況不好，誰說你們會死了？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Can I rest? Shouldn't I get back to work? If I don't work, my family will starve.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我能休息嗎？我不該回去工作嗎？不工作的話，家裡人就沒飯吃了。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Hey, what about me!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
嘿，還有我呢！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I'm sick too! If I sleep, it will be cured in a day!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我也生病了！只要睡一覺，一天就能好！

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Oh. About that. You need professional treatment and care.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
這個嘛...你們需要接受專業治療和護理。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
No, it's not okay. I have to... I need to work.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
不，不行。我必須...我需要工作。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Then you'll really die. I don't think you want to die yet, right?
If you keep working, you will. You need to rest and be treated by professionals.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
再這樣下去你真的會沒命的。你還不想死吧？繼續工作就會出事。你得休息，接受專業治療。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I can't keep working as the Vice President while the Enterprise is in this state.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
企業已經變成這樣，我不能繼續當副總裁。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Are you going to just get rid of us? If it's not you, it'll be someone else!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你們是想把我們甩掉嗎？就算不是你，也會換別人來！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I'll be taking care of this disaster instead. I will do everything to ensure your full recovery.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我會先處理這場災難，盡一切努力讓你們完全康復。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I'm glad to hear not all of you are bad people.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
很高興聽到你們不全是壞人。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
If you are unhealthy, you should focus on getting better first.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
身體不舒服的話，先專心養好身體。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
My Angela... I'll finally be able to see my Angela again....
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我的安吉拉...我終於能再見到安吉拉了...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
But, well... what about us? We're in a relationship...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
但是，嗯...那我們呢？我們是在一起的...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Still, I want to keep working. We can write anywhere right? If we had a seat back at our headquarters...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
可我還是想繼續工作。到哪兒都能寫東西，對吧？總部要是有張桌子給我就好了...

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
I do not know if there are jobs available back at headquarters.
I'll check up on that once.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
我不確定總部有沒有空缺，我會去確認一下。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Isn't there ^0000FFa lot of work^000000 to do here too? There's still waste materials... right? But I don't think the gunmen will stay here for more than a day or two.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
這裡不是也有^0000FF很多工作^000000要做嗎？還有廢料要處理...對吧？不過那些槍手應該待不了一兩天。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
You know, we need people to chop trees, cook, clean, and who will wash our clothes? I don't think it's possible.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你想想，砍樹、做飯、打掃都得有人做，還有誰來洗我們的衣服？你們肯定忙不過來。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What? Are we even strong enough to eat food?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
什麼？我們連自己吃飯都沒力氣嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
No way... we know where to catch the fishes... where the good mushrooms are... where the best spots for the bathroom are... you guy don't know any of that.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
別開玩笑了...我們知道去哪兒捕魚，哪兒能採到好蘑菇，哪兒方便上廁所...你們可不知道這些。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
She's right! Nobody else knows this place as much as we do.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
她說得對！沒人比我們更熟悉這裡。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I understand what they're saying.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我明白他們的意思。

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Hmm... well, I guess we need to keep people here who knows this place. Alright, I've decided.
Anyone who's in good enough shape and wishes to remain can stay here and they will still be hired.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
嗯...看來確實得留下熟悉這裡的人。好，我決定了。身體狀況允許、也願意留下的人，都可以繼續留在這裡工作。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Oh my... thank you....
scripts.translation:
[工人]
天哪...謝謝您...

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Thank you! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
謝謝！謝謝！

scripts.text: These people are victims too...
scripts.translation: 這些人也是受害者...

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
As Lazy was saying, I think Rekenber has used these people because of their desperation.
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
正如懶散所說，我認為雷肯貝爾利用了他們走投無路的處境。

scripts.text:
[Search Team]
We need support from the adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[搜尋隊]
我們需要冒險者的支援！

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
What is it? Are the wounded people okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
怎麼了？傷員們沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Search Team]
We were tracking the attacker, some of us got injured and now we ^0000FFneed backup.^000000
scripts.translation:
[搜尋隊]
我們追蹤襲擊者時，有幾個人受了傷，現在^0000FF需要增援。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kaya]
Attacker?
scripts.translation:
[卡雅]
襲擊者？

scripts.text:
[Search Team]
There were some traps set up, and some of us were injured because of it.
scripts.translation:
[搜尋隊]
那裡設了一些陷阱，我們有人因此受傷了。

scripts.text:
[Search Team]
The Advanced Team has difficulty searching everything on its own,
the adventurer's help would be appreciated! Please join the Search Team on the <NAVI>[left]<INFO>sp_cor,108,130,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>!
scripts.translation:
[搜尋隊]
先遣隊沒法獨自搜遍所有地方，需要冒險者幫忙！請到<NAVI>[左側]<INFO>sp_cor,108,130,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>加入搜尋隊！

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I honestly had no idea this place was hidden here. How the hell did they manage to avoid the surrounding people's attention?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我真的沒想到這裡會藏著這樣一個地方。他們是怎麼避開周圍人注意的？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Hello. Do you need anything?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你好。有什麼需要嗎？

scripts.text: I'm going back to Rudus.
scripts.translation: 我要回魯德斯。

scripts.text: Is there anything I can help with?
scripts.translation: 有什麼我能幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
There is nothing else to ask of you adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
冒險者，沒有其他需要拜託你的事了。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
If you have time, how about you go back to Rudus and find more Identification Bracelets?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
如果你有時間，不妨回到魯德斯，尋找更多的鑑定手鐲？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Hello you're back already adventurer? What's the matter? Do you need anything?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你好，冒險者，這麼快就回來了？
怎麼了？有什麼需要嗎？

scripts.text: I'm going to Rudus.
scripts.translation: 我要去魯德斯。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Already? You've been there for a while today, right? I know it's not easy,You should take a break.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
這麼快？你今天已經在那裡待了一陣子了吧？我知道這不容易，先休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I need some time to sort out the bracelets that you've brought earlier.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我需要一些時間來整理你之前帶來的手鐲。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I'll see you again at dawn.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我們黎明時分再見。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Hello, are you going to Rudus?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你好，你要去魯德斯嗎？

scripts.text: Yes. I'll be going.
scripts.translation: 是的，我會去的。

scripts.text: I can't go today.
scripts.translation: 我今天去不了。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
It's alright, you need to take breaks as well, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
沒關係，冒險者，你也需要休息。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
It won't be easy, but please put to rest 20 ^0000FFDolors specimens^000000 and collect 10 ^0000FFIdentification Bracelets^000000 from them.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
這趟不輕鬆，請讓20只^0000FF多洛爾實驗體^000000安息，並從它們身上收集10個^0000FF身份識別手鐲^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Please be careful. I know you will do well.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
請小心。我相信你會做得很好。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Have you finished the work in Rudus?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你在魯德斯的工作完成了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Oh..., I thought the Vice President told you to put them to rest?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
咦...我還以為副總裁讓你送它們安息了？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Have you finished the work in Rudus?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你在魯德斯的工作完成了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Oh... huh, I thought the Vice President told you to put them to rest?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
咦...我還以為副總裁讓你送它們安息了？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
Have you finished the work in Rudus?
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你在魯德斯的工作完成了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Aas]
You brought ^0000FF10 identification bracelet^000000... Alright, I received them.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
你帶來了^0000FF10個身份識別手鐲^000000...好，我收下了。

scripts.text:
[Aas]
I will see you again at dawn.
You must be pretty tired.
scripts.translation:
[阿斯]
我們黎明時分再見。
你一定很累了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
The <NAVI>[guard]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> seems to have something to say to the VIP. Is it a problem with the wounded people?
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
<NAVI>[衛兵]<INFO>sp_cor,135,147,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>好像有話要跟VIP說。是傷員那邊出問題了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Do you think this is where they are? I have to find the missing people.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你覺得他們在這裡嗎？我必須找到失蹤的人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I really can't believe they did illegal experiments on this place. Why does it look so nice?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我真的不敢相信他們在這裡進行了非法實驗。為什麼這裡看起來這麼漂亮？

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
{0}.
We're still searching, so don't go too deep. We don't know what might be lurking in there.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
{0}。
我們還在搜尋，別走得太深。裡面有什麼東西潛伏著，我們還不清楚。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
You came, Adventurer. You know why I wanted to see you, right?
It's because of that angry researcher who ran away. As you can see, we haven't found him. He's as slippery as an eel.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
你來了，冒險者。知道我為什麼找你吧？那個發怒後逃走的研究員還沒找到。你也看到了，他滑得像條鰻魚。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
I hate untrained animals.
They must be kept on tight leashes to train them properly. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
我討厭沒馴服的動物。
要把它們訓練好，就得用牢牢的牽繩拴住。你說呢？

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Ack, what was that?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
哎呀，那是什麼聲音？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Captain, there was another explosion near the facilities!
That researcher named ^0000CDElyumina^000000 must have done it. We'll go after him right away!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
隊長，設施附近又發生爆炸了！肯定是那個叫^0000CDElyumina^000000的研究員乾的。我們馬上追他！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
So, he knows he can't take us head-on. He's using guerrilla tactics.
Let's go. {0}, follow me <NAVI>[this way]<INFO>sp_cor,180,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
看來他知道自己打不過我們，所以改用游擊戰術了。
走吧，{0}，跟我來<NAVI>[這邊]<INFO>sp_cor,180,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
There was an explosion near the facilities. It was caused by that researcher at this lab, Elyumina.
We must capture him without fail this time. Come <NAVI>[this way]<INFO>sp_cor,180,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
設施附近發生了爆炸，是這間實驗室的研究員艾露米娜乾的。
這次一定要抓住他。跟我來<NAVI>[這邊]<INFO>sp_cor,180,169,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
I hate untrained animals.
They must be kept on tight leashes to train them properly. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
我討厭沒馴服的動物。
要把它們訓練好，就得用牢牢的牽繩拴住。你說呢？

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Mm? Adventurer, don't act on your own. I know I can trust you, but the others don't.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
嗯？冒險者，不要擅自行動。雖然我知道可以信任你，但其他人不一定。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Some of the researchers or their devices can remain. Stay with the others in the areas we've cleared.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
可以留下部分研究員和裝置。你去已經清理過的區域，和其他人待在一起。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
What about me? Why am I here alone? Are you worried about me? Ho ho ho!
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
那我呢？為什麼只有我一個人留在這裡？你在擔心我嗎？呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
You're a bit late. Well, we didn't come exactly in time, either.
We lost Elyumina. He may not be a good fighter, but he's really good at running. Drat!
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
你來晚了。其實我們也沒能及時趕到。
艾露米娜跑了。他打架不怎麼樣，逃跑倒是一流。可惡！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
We won't be able to search or restore this area unless we catch him first.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
不先抓住他，我們就沒法繼續搜查和恢復這個區域。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
I talked to the other captains of the Rebellion, and have decided to evacuate everyone in this area and release our elite troops for his search.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
我和反叛者的其他隊長商量過了，決定疏散這一區域的所有人，並派出精銳部隊搜捕他。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
The evacuation process has already begun, moving the civilians and the President's little soldiers out of the area.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
疏散已經開始，平民和總統的那些小士兵正陸續撤離這一區域。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
The elite members of USU and the other Rebellion forces have been selected, and I'll be their commander. The rest of the Rebellion will keep all the entries to Cor blocked.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
USU和反叛者其他部隊的精銳已經選出，由我擔任指揮。其餘反叛者會封鎖柯爾的所有入口。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Our operation also includes you, Adventurer. I know how good you are, so I've recommended you to the others. You'll do this with us, won't you?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
冒險者，這次行動也有你的一份。我知道你實力出眾，已經向其他人推薦了你。願意和我們一起行動吧？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 當然可以。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Alright!
For this operation, we've only picked the soldiers who are strong enough to fend for themselves, such as me. Please come back in a ^0000Cdparty of 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
很好！
這次行動只選了能獨當一面計程車兵，比如我。請以^0000Cd1人隊伍^000000回來。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
I hate untrained animals.
They must be kept on tight leashes to train them properly.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
我討厭未經馴服的動物。
必須用緊繩拴住它們，才能好好訓練。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Hey, Adventurer. Why didn't you tell me you did what I asked? I almost asked you again.
But no need to report to me now. My men already did on your behalf.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
喂，冒險者，你辦完我交代的事怎麼沒告訴我？我差點又問你一遍。
不過不用匯報了，我的人已經替你報告過了。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
The area has been closed. The evacuation process is almost complete.
We'll go in there soon. Soldiers, are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
這一區域已經封鎖，疏散也快完成了。
我們很快就要進去。士兵們，準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Alright, you're the elite of the elites in the Rebellion, especially picked to capture this researcher who's been attacking everyone in this area, friend and foe alike.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
很好，你們是反叛者中的精銳。我特意挑選你們來抓捕那個不分敵我的襲擊者。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
As for you, Adventurer, please select Ready and wait for us.
When MD is activated, select Enter. Our operation will begin as soon as you do.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
冒險者，請選擇“準備”，然後等我們就位。
副本開啟後，選擇“進入”。你一進來，行動就會開始。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Please note that you can't clear this dungeon if you try to tame monsters or perform any other irrelevant monster-related activities.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000請注意：馴服魔物或進行其他無關的魔物相關活動，會導致你無法完成此副本。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
I told you, you have to do this alone.
Use the ^0000Cd/organize [party name]^000000 command and come back in a ^0000Cdparty of 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
我說過，你必須獨自行動。
使用^0000Cd/organize [隊伍名稱]^000000指令，組建^0000Cd1人隊伍^000000後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Wait, are you trying to take other adventurers with you?
I trust you, but I don't know about your friends. Please come back in a ^0000Cdparty of 1^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
等等，你想帶其他冒險者一起去？
我信任你，可不瞭解你的同伴。請以^0000Cd1人隊伍^000000回來。

scripts.text: Ready
scripts.translation: 準備

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
There seems to be a problem. Your request has failed. Please try again later. If the problem persists, please contact the Operation Team.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
好像出了點問題，申請失敗了。請稍後再試。如果問題依舊，請聯絡運營團隊。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Alright, if MD is activated, talk to me again and select ^0000CDEnter^000000. Our operation will begin as soon as you enter.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
副本開啟後，再來找我並選擇^0000CD進入^000000。你一進去，行動就會開始。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Your party leader hasn't created the dungeon. Check with them.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
隊長還沒有建立副本，請聯絡隊長。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
The dungeon is not created yet. Check again.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
副本尚未建立。請再次檢查。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
What kind of error is this? Check it.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
這是什麼錯誤？檢查一下。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
What is it? What, are you nervous? You look nervous.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
怎麼了？緊張了？看你一臉緊張。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
There seems to be a problem. If I unnecessarily repeat myself, you should contact the Operation Team.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
好像出了點問題。如果我一直重複同樣的話，請聯絡運營團隊。

scripts.text:
[Alert]
 - Your bag is full. Please check your weight and carrying item quantity, and then talk to me again. -
scripts.translation:
[警報]
 - 你的背包已滿。請檢查你的負重和攜帶物品數量，然後再次與我交談。 -

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Good job, everyone! Ho ho! You guys, I knew I could trust you!
Ah, Adventurer, you too. Good job!
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
大家幹得漂亮！呵呵，我就知道你們靠得住！
冒險者，你也做得很好！

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Thanks to you, we've successfully captured Elyumina. Now that we don't have to worry about his random attacks, the President's little soldiers and the civilians can go back home.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
多虧了你，我們成功抓住了艾露米娜。他不會再四處襲擊人了，總統的那些小士兵和平民也能回家了。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Rookie and the President's soldiers called the Wings something are getting ready to interrogate him.
They're clearing the place that you fought the last machine to use it as an interrogation room.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
新人和總統麾下的翼族士兵正準備審問他。
他們正在清理你最後和機器交戰的地方，打算把那裡改成審訊室。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Since I'm the type who prefers force over talking to get the answer she wants, I probably won't have anything to do there,
but maybe Goni and I can stand in the back, glaring daggers at him.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
我比較喜歡用拳頭逼出答案，不太會審問，所以可能幫不上忙。不過我和戈尼可以站在後面瞪他。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Why don't you come join us <NAVI>[there]<INFO>sp_cor,136,210,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>?
You can stand next to us and glare, or you can help Rookie interrogate.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
要不要來<NAVI>[那邊]<INFO>sp_cor,136,210,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>找我們？
你可以和我們一起瞪他，也可以幫新人審問。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
There seems to be a problem. If I unnecessarily repeat myself, you should contact the Operation Team.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
似乎出現了問題。如果我不得不重複自己，你應該聯絡運營團隊。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Rookie and the President's soldiers called the Wings something are getting ready to interrogate him.
They're clearing the place that you fought the last machine to use it as an interrogation room.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
新人和總統麾下的翼族士兵正準備審問他。
他們正在清理你最後和機器交戰的地方，打算把那裡改成審訊室。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Since I'm the type who prefers force over talking to get the answer she wants, I probably won't have anything to do there,
but maybe Goni and I can stand in the back, glaring daggers at him.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
我比較喜歡用拳頭逼出答案，不太會審問，所以可能幫不上忙。不過我和戈尼可以站在後面瞪他。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Why don't you come join us <NAVI>[there]<INFO>sp_cor,136,210,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>?
You can stand next to us and glare, or you can help Rookie interrogate.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
要不要來<NAVI>[那邊]<INFO>sp_cor,136,210,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>找我們？
你可以和我們一起瞪他，也可以幫新人審問。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Hey, are you busy?
I'll be traveling often between here and the Rebellion base for a while.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
嘿，你有空嗎？
接下來一陣子，我會經常往返這裡和反叛者基地。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Places like this are prone to accidents that the regular members of the Rebellion can't handle.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
這種地方很容易出事，反叛者的普通成員未必應付得來。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
When you finally have some time, come to Clana Nemieri for another match with me.
I don't hate destroying machines, but it's not as fun as fighting you.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
等你有空的時候，來夜巡者轉職考試地點再和我切磋一下吧。
我並不討厭破壞機器，但和你戰鬥更有趣。

scripts.text:
[Goni]
...

[Goni]
*Nod*
scripts.translation:
[戈尼]
*點頭*

scripts.text:
[Goni]
...

[Rookie]
Ah, you came early. I thought you'd come later after a break.
Mr. Lazy, please bring out the prisoner.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
啊，你來得挺早。我還以為你會休息一會兒再來。
懶散先生，請把犯人帶出來。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Yes, sir. Here he is.
It hasn't been that long since we met, and you're already bossing me around.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
是，長官。犯人在這兒。
我們才剛見面，你就開始對我發號施令了。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
I knew you had it in you, Lucky Rookie. I've got a good eye for people. I'm so amazing!
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
我就知道你行，拉基新人！我看人最準了，我可真厲害！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Gah, you fools! Stop manhandling me! My body's precious! I'm more valuable than all of you muscleheads combined!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
啊，你們這群蠢貨！別對我動手動腳！我的身體珍貴得很！比你們這群肌肉笨蛋加起來都值錢！

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Oops, sorry. Now, Rookie, good luck to you.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
哎呀，抱歉。好了，新人，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Goni]
...

[Goni]
...?

[Rookie]
This shouldn't have happened.
Please contact the Operation Team.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不該出這種問題。
請聯絡運營團隊。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Err, then...
(Am I really interrogating him?)
scripts.translation:
[新人]
呃...接下來...
（我真的在審問他嗎？）

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... Hey, take it easy. You're in no position to demand anything.
You've done some serious damage to us.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
...喂，老實點。你現在沒資格提要求。
你給我們造成了嚴重損失。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Stuff it! What about the damage you've done on me?
You invaded my lab and tried to steal my research results!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
少廢話！你們給我造成的損失呢？闖進我的實驗室，還想偷走我的研究成果！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you mean your illegal experimentation results,
didn't you know they might get you in trouble one day?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
如果你說的是非法實驗成果，難道你不知道總有一天會惹上麻煩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Well, that doesn't matter. You care about your research, don't you?
Cooperate with us, and we'll help you continue with it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
算了，這不重要。你很看重自己的研究，對吧？配合我們，我們就讓你繼續研究。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Only the part that's legal, of course. But we'll make sure you can keep it. So, tell us everything you know about this place and your coworkers.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
當然，只能繼續合法的部分。不過我們會盡量保住這部分研究。告訴我們這裡的情況，還有你的同事們的事。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
My coworkers? I don't care about those lunatics.
They're not my coworkers. I only used them for my research.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
同事？我才不在乎那些瘋子。
他們不是我的同事，只是我拿來做研究的物件。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Come to think of it, your name wasn't on the employee list from the company.
Who are you? What kind of research did you need them for?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
說起來，公司員工名單上沒有你的名字。你究竟是誰？為什麼需要他們配合你的研究？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Don't you know who I am? I'm Schwarzwald's--no, the continent's greatest machine learning researcher. I bet you all have seen my serviceroids.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你們不知道我是誰嗎？我是修瓦魯茲巴魯德——不，是全大陸最偉大的機器學習研究員！你們肯定見過我造的服務機器人。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... Nope.

[Elyumina]
Hmpf, you probably didn't even know they were serviceroids.
I was so close to transplanting human minds into my machines.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
哼，你們大概連那些是服務機器人都不知道。
我差一點就能把人類的意識移植進機器裡了。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
I could have given you my beautiful machine bodies, so you could forever preserve the knowledge that you all have worked so hard to accumulate.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
我本可以給你們換上漂亮的機械身體，讓你們辛苦積累的知識永遠儲存下去。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Do you get it? I was doing something greater than any one of you fools can imagine.
My research is nothing compared to the childish works of Vor, Wer, whatever their names were.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
懂了嗎？我做的是你們這些蠢貨想都想不到的偉大事業。沃爾、韋爾...不管他們叫什麼，他們做的東西跟我的研究比起來幼稚極了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Vor-who? Vorseff? Or Werner? Do you know them?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
沃爾...誰？沃塞夫？還是維爾納？你認識他們？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Well, I know both names, but they don't interest me. Both of them risked their lives for stupid things.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
嗯，這兩個名字我都知道，但我對他們沒興趣。他們倆都為愚蠢的事情冒了生命危險。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Maybe it's time you should take more interest. We want you to talk.
Listen up. You've got two choices.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
也許你是時候多關心一下他們了。我們要你開口。聽著，你有兩個選擇。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
First, you could decide to be stubborn
and not to tell us about your illegal research or your friends.
You stay loyal to them in exchange for... The death sentence. In this case, you'll have no future.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
第一，繼續頑抗，不肯告訴我們你的非法研究和同夥的事。
你可以繼續效忠他們，代價就是...死刑。這樣一來，你就沒有未來了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Or you could be more considerate of your future
and provide us information about your coworkers who were only your business partners. In this case, you'll get to keep your research, though in a limited capacity.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
第二，為自己的未來著想，告訴我們那些只是你生意夥伴的同夥的情況。這樣你還能保留部分研究成果，但會受到限制。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You'll have to pay for what you did, of course, but eventually, you'll be able to do what you want.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
當然，你得為自己的所作所為付出代價。不過最後，你還是能繼續做自己想做的事。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
...
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We're offering you a plea bargain. We're making sacrifices by offering it to you because we really believe you're onto something great.
I hope you'll make the right decision.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們願意和你做認罪協商，相信你的研究確有價值，所以才肯作出讓步。希望你能作出正確的選擇。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
... I really don't know what the others did in their rooms.
...Can I still keep the bargain?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
...我真的不知道其他人都在各自的房間裡做什麼。
...我還能接受這個條件嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Mm... Sure, why not? If you cooperate with us as best as you can, then we can let the minor details slide.
Now, let's get down to the business, shall we? Please send him here, Mr. Lazy.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
嗯...當然可以。你儘量配合，我們就不追究那些無關緊要的細節。
好了，開始辦正事吧。懶散先生，把他帶過來。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
...

[Lazy]
...
Hey, Hot-blooded Captain over there.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
...
喂，那邊那位熱血船長。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
... Are you talking to me?
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
...你在跟我說話？

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Then, who else? You're the only captain here.
I was just going to ask you to stop glaring, since he's cooperating now.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
不然呢？這裡只有你一位船長。
我只是想請你別再瞪他了，他現在已經願意配合。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Ah... Mm, yes.
Rookie did a great job. I didn't know he was so good at persuasion.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
啊...嗯，說得也是。
新人做得不錯，沒想到他這麼會勸人。

scripts.text:
[Lazy]
Of course not. You never gave him a chance.
But now that you know, let him handle the rest.
scripts.translation:
[懶散]
你當然不知道，你從沒給過他機會。
現在既然知道了，剩下的就交給他吧。

scripts.text:
[Elena]
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
What were you guys talking about? He told me everything we need to know.
His group was called ^0000CDIllusion^000000, consisting of ^0000Cdformer members of Regenschirm^000000.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你們剛才聊什麼呢？他已經把我們需要知道的都說了。
他的組織叫^0000CD幻覺^000000，成員是^0000Cd雷根修蘆的前成員^000000。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Elyumina doesn't seem to know a lot about his group, though.
He had almost zero contact with the company. He received his funds from Illusion in exchange for his research results. That was why he wasn't on the list.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不過艾露米娜對組織瞭解不多。他幾乎不和公司往來，而是把研究成果交給幻覺來換取資金，所以名單上沒有他。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
And beyond this lab site is ^0000CDBarmund's mansion^000000, which used to be hidden.
Illusion was created after the mansion's discovery, to monopolize on the knowledge available inside the place.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
實驗室遺址外面是^0000CDBarmund的宅邸^000000，過去那裡一直隱蔽不為人知。
幻覺是在宅邸被發現後成立的，想獨佔其中的知識。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Elyumina doesn't know how the mansion looks like on the inside
because she chose to stay behind the others who entered the mansion, to protect his research data.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
艾露米娜不知道宅邸內部是什麼樣，因為其他人進入宅邸時，他選擇留在後面保護自己的研究資料。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Through the <NAVI>[waterway]<INFO>sp_cor,255,285,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> on the far right side of the fence.
We need more information and also have to round up the researchers. Why don't we all go together? Captain? Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
從圍欄最右側的<NAVI>[水道]<INFO>sp_cor,255,285,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>過去。
我們還得查明更多情況，並把研究員們帶來。大家一起行動吧，船長、冒險者，你們覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Through the <NAVI>[waterway]<INFO>sp_cor,255,285,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> on the far right side of the fence.
We need more information and also have to round up the researchers. Why don't we all go together? Captain? Adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
從圍欄最右側的<NAVI>[水道]<INFO>sp_cor,255,285,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>過去。
我們還得查明更多情況，並把研究員們帶來。大家一起行動吧，船長、冒險者，你們覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, you'll be the first one to know I have news.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，有訊息我會第一個告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Erm, we're still investigating this side, Adventurer.
We don't know what kind of danger lurks here. Please don't come any closer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，我們還在調查這一側。裡面有什麼危險還不清楚，請別再靠近。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The water in this waterway looks clean, but we want to send it for an analysis.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
水道里的水看起來很乾淨，不過我們還是要送去化驗。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
This place is filled with so many unpleasant surprises that I'm constantly reminding myself to be wary of everything I see.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這裡到處都是意想不到的麻煩，我得提醒自己對看到的一切都保持警惕。

scripts.text:
[Alert]
 - Your bag is full. Please check your weight and carrying item quantity, and then talk to me again. -
scripts.translation:
[警報]
 - 你的背包已滿。請檢查你的負重和攜帶物品數量，然後再次與我交談。 -

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Ah, man. I think this is, but I can't open it. Is it too rusty or what?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
唉，我覺得就是這個，可怎麼也打不開。是鏽得太厲害了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Goni]
...

[Rookie]
Ah, you want to try? Thank you, Goni.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
啊，你想試試嗎？謝謝你，戈尼。

scripts.text:
[Goni]
...

[Rookie]
Goni, are you serious? Ooh, I see. Interesting...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
戈尼，你是認真的嗎？哦，我懂了...有意思。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Why are you looking at me like that? I told you nothing but the truth. That really is the entrance.
Why would I lie in a situation like that? I'm not that stupid, you know.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
幹嗎這麼看著我？我說的都是實話，那裡確實是入口。
這種時候我騙你們幹什麼？我又沒那麼蠢。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Who says you are? We've found the entrance.
But it's locked from the inside. Even Goni couldn't open it, and he's the strongest of us all. That's what I find interesting.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
誰說你蠢了？入口是找到了，可門從裡面鎖上了。連我們中最強的戈尼都打不開，這才有意思。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I should have checked if you talked to the others before you talked to us. Now, it's too late.
You're more loyal than I thought. Not stupid, either.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我應該先問問你有沒有和其他人談過，再讓你來找我們。現在已經晚了。
看來你比我想的更忠誠，也沒那麼蠢。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Adventurer, the Rebellion will keep this place surrounded and investigate the perimeter.
Now that we know what that place is, we can't leave it alone.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，反叛者會包圍這裡並搜查周邊。既然知道了這裡是什麼地方，我們就不能置之不理。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We have a long love-and-hate relationship with both the government and the company. Even if Illusion isn't related to either of them, we must retrieve Barmund's legacy from it.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們和政府、公司之間恩怨糾纏。就算幻覺和他們都沒關係，我們也得從那裡取回巴姆德的遺產。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
But for now, we can't get in because the gate is shut.
I'll let you know if we come across more information. Until then, please get some rest.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不過大門關著，我們暫時進不去。等有新訊息我會告訴你。在那之前先休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
Ah, right. Elyumina will also be kept here for a while.
He knows Illusion better than we do. We can't afford to lose him.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
對了，艾露米娜也會暫時留在這裡。他比我們更瞭解幻覺，我們不能放走他。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
While he's with us, we'll also see if he can modify the damaged weapons found here for us.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
他留在這裡時，我們也會讓他試著改造在這裡發現的損壞武器。

scripts.text:
[Elena Volkova]
If you're interested in that, you can ask my smart <NAVI>[subordinates]<INFO>sp_cor,108,130,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> for more details.
scripts.translation:
[埃琳娜·沃爾科娃]
想了解詳情的話，可以去問我那位聰明的<NAVI>[部下]<INFO>sp_cor,108,130,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There are still many things to do around here. If you're not busy, maybe you can stay and help us.
Now, good luck, Adventurer! We'll contact you if we come across new information!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這裡還有不少事要做。你要是不忙，也留下來幫幫我們吧。
祝你好運，冒險者！有新訊息我會聯絡你！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I'll get back to you when I get more info. So take a break for a while.
Elyumina should also be in charge here for the time being.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
等我有新訊息再聯絡你。你先休息一會兒吧。
艾露米娜暫時也會負責這裡的事務。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
We'll keep an eye on it and suggest modifying the damaged weapons we can get here for our own use.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們會繼續留意，也打算把在這裡找到的損壞武器改造後自用。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you're an adventurer, if you're interested, it's managed by Captain Volkova's <NAVI>[subordinates]<INFO>sp_cor,108,130,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, so go and ask.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，你要是對此感興趣，就去問問負責此事的沃爾科娃船長的<NAVI>[部下]<INFO>sp_cor,108,130,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There's still quite a bit of work to do around here, so if you're free, feel free to help out.
Then good luck, adventurer! I'll be in touch when I learn something new!
scripts.translation:
[新人]
這裡還有不少活兒，你有空就來幫忙吧。
祝你好運，冒險者！有新訊息我會聯絡你！

scripts.text: ^4d4dffThese quests are available from level 130 or higher.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff這些任務需要等級130或以上才能接取。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
You're welcome.
I opened the entrance here last night.
Elyumina said that somehow the device that was sealing it from the inside is broken.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不客氣。昨晚我打開了這裡的入口。
艾露米娜說，不知為何，從裡面封住入口的裝置壞了。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
It must have been one of the devices of the Illusion and Heart Hunters to keep the entrance shut.
I'm glad that we're able to open it and move inside.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那應該是幻覺和心之獵手用來封鎖入口的裝置。還好我們能開啟它，繼續往裡調查。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Some of the rebellions have already entered the mansion.
Maybe the Illusions intended to open it... because the inside is full of experiments...
scripts.translation:
[新人]
已經有反叛者進入宅邸了。
也許幻覺打算開啟入口...畢竟裡面堆滿了實驗品...

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
but I'm sure the rebellions who entered the mansion, is fine.
You can enter whenever you're ready, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
不過，進去的反叛者應該沒事。冒險者，你準備好後隨時可以進去。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Even though I opened it, I don't plan to leave the door open at all times.
I was only waiting for you to come.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
雖然入口是我開啟的，但我不會一直敞著門。
我只是在等你來。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
... Hmm, for some reason, I feel like I'm always playing the role of a gatekeeper?
Is it only for adventurers? You must be feeling bad, huh? Ha-ha-ha-ha
scripts.translation:
[新人]
...嗯，不知怎麼的，我好像總在當守門人？
我只對冒險者這樣嗎？你一定覺得挺不好意思吧？哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I'll open the door anytime you need to need, adventurer. Just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
冒險者，你需要時我隨時可以開門，告訴我一聲就行。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Shall we go?
To the great mansion left by the great sages?
scripts.translation:
[新人]
準備好出發了嗎？
去那座偉大賢者留下的宏偉宅邸？

scripts.text: Let's Go!
scripts.translation: 出發！

scripts.text: Not now.
scripts.translation: 現在不行。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Let me know whenever you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
當你準備好時，隨時告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
I heard that the advance team already cleaned up the inside, but occasionally something is coming out this way... it's hard for me to see something sticking out this way from time to time.
First, I'll tell you where to go.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我聽說先遣隊已經清理過裡面了，不過偶爾還是有東西從那邊冒出來...時不時看到東西探出來，真讓人不安。
我先告訴你路線。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The gate you're about to enter... we're calling it the entrance, but it's actually the exit.
It's a giant sewer. If you walk along the sewer, you'll find a huge sewage treatment plant inside.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
你要進的這道門，我們叫它入口，其實是出口。
裡面是條巨大的下水道，沿著它走就能找到一座大型汙水處理廠。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you go past the sewage treatment plant, there is a one huge magic power plant inside.
It seems that power plant supports the entire mansion.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
穿過汙水處理廠，裡面還有一座大型魔力發電廠。
整座宅邸似乎都靠它供能。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Through the power plant, you can get to the garden of mansion.
The mansion's manager is staying near the garden. be sure to meet them first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
穿過發電廠就能到宅邸花園。宅邸的管理員住在花園附近，記得先去見他。

scripts.text: Manager?
scripts.translation: 管理員？

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
If you look around closely, you'll understand.
They seem to be having a hard time because of the intruders.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
仔細看看你就明白了。他們似乎正被入侵者逼得走投無路。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Many other volunteer adventurer have entered before us.
The sewage plant is quite complicated and you could get lost.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
我們之前已經有不少志願冒險者進去過了。汙水處理廠結構很複雜，你可能會迷路。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There might be a colleague that ^4D4DFFfell behind^000000, Please move together with them.
Before you register as a guest in the mansion, prioritize everyone's safety first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
可能有同伴^4D4DFF掉隊了^000000，請和他們一起行動。
在登記成為宅邸訪客之前，先確保所有人的安全。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Then, this way.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
那麼，這邊請。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
Go ahead and enter the mansion through this sewer.
Most of the colleagues who went in first cleaned up already.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
從這條下水道進入宅邸吧。先進去的同伴已經清理了大部分割槽域。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
There might be a colleague that ^4D4DFFfell behind^000000, Please move together with them.
Before you register as a guest in the mansion, prioritize everyone's safety first.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
可能有同伴^4D4DFF掉隊了^000000，請和他們一起行動。
在登記成為宅邸訪客之前，先確保所有人的安全。

scripts.text:
[Rookie]
The path we took with you adventurer is a fresh feeling for me.
I feel really alive these days.
scripts.translation:
[新人]
和你這位冒險者一起走過這些路，感覺很新鮮。
最近我覺得自己特別有活力。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I'll have to split the workforce because I only have so few people remaining.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
現在剩下的人手不多，我只好把他們分開安排。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
We'll have to take turns.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我們得輪流工作。

scripts.text: Do you know Patrick Kaufmann?
scripts.translation: 你認識帕特里克·考夫曼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Who?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
誰？

scripts.text: Patrick Kaufmann. Facility Maintenance Officer.
scripts.translation: 帕特里克·考夫曼，設施維護部門的軍官。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Patrick Kaufmann? Don't you mean Patrick Young?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
帕特里克·考夫曼？你指的是帕特里克·楊吧？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
He's the logistic guy.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
他是負責後勤的那個人。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Where's the facility department here?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
這裡的設施部門在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I knew before I came here!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我來這裡之前就知道這件事！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Patrick is in the Facility Maintenance Department? That I didn't know. Nobody here worked as their usual job. When I got here, I was assigned a different job.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
帕特里克在設施維護部門？我還真不知道。這裡的人都沒做原來的工作，我剛來就被安排了別的活兒。

scripts.text: Who decides what you guys do?
scripts.translation: 誰決定你們做什麼工作？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Who decides? It's the researchers.
When we arrived here, we were set up in a line and then one after the other, we were interviewed. Then we were assigned a job.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
是研究員決定的。
我們剛來時先排成一隊，研究員挨個面試，然後給每個人分配工作。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
When I think about it, his eyes were so beautiful.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
現在想起來，他的眼睛真漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Anyway, if you're looking for someone in particular, you should ^0000FFask the researchers.^000000 Most of them already ran away, but a few stayed behind.
The <NAVI>[researcher]<INFO>sp_cor,224,77,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> right next to the crops. Do you see her?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
總之，你要找特定的人，最好^0000FF去問問研究員。^000000大部分人都跑了，不過還有幾位留了下來。
看到作物旁邊的<NAVI>[研究員]<INFO>sp_cor,224,77,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Anyway, if you're looking for someone in particular, you should ^0000FFask the researchers.^000000 Most of them already ran away, but a few stayed behind.
The <NAVI>[researcher]<INFO>sp_cor,224,77,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> right next to the crops. Do you see her?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
總之，你要找特定的人，最好^0000FF去問問研究員。^000000大部分人都跑了，不過還有幾位留了下來。
看到作物旁邊的<NAVI>[研究員]<INFO>sp_cor,224,77,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Now I can't think of anything else, I'm in a bad mood. I'll get back to work soon...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我現在什麼也想不出來，心情也不好。我得回去幹活了...

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Anyway, what about all of these...?
It's too bad that they won't be used.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
話說回來，這些東西該怎麼辦...？
用不上它們的話就太可惜了。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
You... you're the adventurer that came with the gunmen. Am I in trouble? I didn't know anything about these illegal experiments or the institute.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
你...你是和那些槍手一起來的冒險者？我會不會有麻煩？我對非法實驗和研究所的事一無所知。

scripts.text: I'm looking for a person.
scripts.translation: 我在找一個人。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Who? Patrick? I don't know him. I don't know many people, I'm only focused on the field work here.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
誰？帕特里克？我不認識他。我不太認識其他人，一直只顧著這裡的田間工作。

scripts.text: Why are the researchers doing the field work?
scripts.translation: 為什麼研究員要做田間工作？

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Well... in short, it was to feed the study animals, I was growing super vegetables that would sustain the animals for life.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
嗯...簡單說，就是種來喂實驗動物的。我在培育能讓它們一輩子吃不完的超級蔬菜。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Processing and refining the vegetables... with these... what were they trying to do?? Did they try solve the hunger problems?
Actually, I don't know. Maybe you do.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
把蔬菜加工、提煉成這樣...他們到底想做什麼？想解決饑荒嗎？
其實我也不知道。也許你知道。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
The chief researchers here know all the details. I honestly didn't know they would just leave like that. I thought they were like a family to me...
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
這裡的首席研究員知道所有內情。說實話，我沒想到他們會就這麼離開。我一直把他們當家人...

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
The chief told me to pack my bags because there was a disturbance outside. I was hesitating because I had to take care of my crops, but then everyone had already left.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
首席讓我收拾行李，說外面出了騷動。我本來還猶豫著要不要走，畢竟得照料作物，可等我回過神來，大家都已經走了。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
I understood the moment I heard the Vice President talking. I worked with pride, but I was only making consumables for my senior researcher in the end.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
聽到副總裁的話後，我才明白過來。我一直以工作為榮，到頭來卻只是在替上級研究員製造消耗品。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
After all, I was blinded by my own ego. I didn't realize anything of what was happening.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
說到底，是我太自負，矇蔽了自己，才沒看清發生的一切。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Anyway, I'm looking for a <NAVI>[person]<INFO>sp_cor,151,180,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> to do my laundry. It's been a while and my feet are dirty.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
總之，我在找一個<NAVI>[人]<INFO>sp_cor,151,180,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>幫我洗衣服。衣服好久沒洗了，我的腳都髒了。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Anyway, I'm looking for a <NAVI>[person]<INFO>sp_cor,151,180,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI> to do my laundry. It's been a while and my feet are dirty.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
總之，我在找一個<NAVI>[人]<INFO>sp_cor,151,180,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>幫我洗衣服。衣服好久沒洗了，腳都髒了。

scripts.text:
[Researcher]
Anyway, how about all of these...?
I'm afraid they will go to waste if I just leave.
scripts.translation:
[研究員]
話說回來，這些東西該怎麼辦...？
就這麼放著不管，恐怕會浪費掉。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Huh... I don't want to wash these things, uh... it seems like the inside is burnt.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
呃...我可不想洗這些東西...裡面好像燒焦了。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Hey, don't come any closer. These are contaminated items. Look out.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
喂，別靠近。這些東西受汙染了，小心點。

scripts.text: I have something to ask you.
scripts.translation: 我有事想問你。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Oh, you saved us! My name is Marcus. What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
啊，你救了我們！我叫馬庫斯。你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Marcus Holzman from Lighthalzen?
scripts.translation: 來自裡希塔樂鎮的馬庫斯·霍爾茨曼？

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
Do you know me? I don't know you....
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
你認識我？可我不認識你...

scripts.text: Are you familiar with Eva?
scripts.translation: 你認識伊娃嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
No, who are you, really? How do you know Eva Mueller? Did Eva send you? How is she doing? Oh my god! Eva! How is Eva doing?
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
不，你到底是誰？你怎麼認識伊娃·穆勒？是伊娃派你來的嗎？她怎麼樣了？天哪，伊娃過得好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
Eva, I want to see Eva again. Did she forget about me? I haven't been able to contact her for several years.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
伊娃...我好想再見她一面。她是不是把我忘了？我已經好幾年沒法聯絡她了。

scripts.text: She worries because she hasn't been contacted.
scripts.translation: 她擔心一直收不到你的訊息。

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
I couldn't send letters. I couldn't contact the outside either, and I can't get out of here. These are the rules of this place.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
我寄不出信，也聯絡不上外面的人，更沒法離開這裡。這就是這裡的規矩。

scripts.text: Well, it says you're on vacation.
scripts.translation: 嗯，上面寫著你正在休假。

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
Vacation? I've been working everyday since I've came here. What makes you say that?
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
休假？我來這裡後天天都在工作。你為什麼這麼說？

scripts.text: I'm investigating missing people.
scripts.translation: 我在調查失蹤人口。

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
I can't thank you enough.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
我感激不盡。

scripts.text: I can forward your letters for you.
scripts.translation: 我可以幫你轉寄信件。

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
Really... you'd do that for me.... if we had meet sooner, we'd have been long life friends. If you need help with anything, let me know.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
真的...你願意幫我？...要是早點認識你，我們早就是一輩子的朋友了。有什麼需要幫忙的，儘管告訴我。

scripts.text: Do you know Patrick Kaufmann?
scripts.translation: 你認識帕特里克·考夫曼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
It's a familiar name... Patrick... Patrick... Are you talking about Pat who was cleaning the labs?
Wasn't he the guy who came from Lighthalzen too?
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
這名字聽著耳熟...帕特里克...帕特里克...你說的是在實驗室打掃衛生的帕特嗎？他也是從裡希塔樂鎮來的吧？

scripts.text: Yes, that's him.
scripts.translation: 是的，就是他。

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
That's right, that's right! The guy who looked tall and big. I wanted to be his friend because we came from the same place. I couldn't see him one day. Then I was moved.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
對，對！那個高大魁梧的傢伙。我也是從同一個地方來的，所以想和他交朋友。後來有一天我沒再見到他，接著就被調走了。

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
It was a Facility Maintenance Department, I told them things weren't supposed to work that way.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
他在設施維護部門。我還跟他們說過，事情不該這麼辦。

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
I'm ^0000FFfamiliar with the people^000000 who work in the lab, I've seen him a few times as I passed by. Did he stop working there?
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
我^0000FF認識實驗室裡的人^000000，路過時見過他幾次。他不在那裡工作了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
Anyway, if you want to know more, check out the <NAVI>[incinerator]<INFO>sp_cor,70,263,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
They're working on collecting and sorting the scattered materials, so maybe they know something else about Pat.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
想打聽更多的話，就去<NAVI>[焚化爐]<INFO>sp_cor,70,263,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>看看。
他們正在收集、整理散落的材料，也許有人知道帕特的事。

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
These laundries will be moved to the incinerator soon. Huh, not good. If you pass them once in the washing machine, they won't always be clean...
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
這些衣物很快就要送去焚化了。唉，真可惜。用洗衣機洗一遍，也不見得就能洗乾淨...

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
Thank you. I have written many letters during my stay, so I'll sort them out. Thank you again!
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
謝謝。我在這裡期間寫了不少信，得先整理一下。再次謝謝你！

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
Anyway, if you want to know more, check out the <NAVI>[incinerator]<INFO>sp_cor,70,263,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
They're working on collecting and sorting the scattered materials, so maybe they know something else about Pat.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
想打聽更多的話，就去<NAVI>[焚化爐]<INFO>sp_cor,70,263,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>看看。
他們正在收集、整理散落的材料，也許有人知道帕特的事。

scripts.text:
[Marcus]
Huh... I don't want to wash these things, uh... it seems like the inside is burnt.
scripts.translation:
[馬庫斯]
嗯...我可不想洗這些東西...裡面好像燒焦了。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Don't put food waste in there. It will smell.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
別把廚餘扔進去，會臭的。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Oh... did you come to pick up the materials? I have arranged it as best as I could, but I cannot classify it because I don't know what it is.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
哦...你是來領材料的？我已經儘量整理過了，但不知道它們是什麼，沒法分類。

scripts.text: Can I have a look?
scripts.translation: 我能看看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Of course. But do you really think there's something of value in there? They would have taken it before leaving.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
當然可以。不過你真覺得裡面有值錢的東西？他們離開時早就拿走了吧。

scripts.text: Is all the garbage incinerated here?
scripts.translation: 所有的垃圾都在這裡焚燒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Well, to be accurate, this is not an incinerator, it's just a temporary loading station that collects garbage before they are incinerated. The actual incinerator is farther away.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
嚴格來說，這裡不是焚化爐，只是暫存垃圾、等著運去焚燒的裝載站。真正的焚化爐還在更遠的地方。

scripts.text: How do the researchers handle the garbage?
scripts.translation: 研究員們如何處理垃圾？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
We collect the garbage from each room and then process it. Well, usually that's what we do for neat people. They don't say much.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我們把各個房間的垃圾收集起來再處理。通常整潔的人會這麼做，他們話不多。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
How can they call themselves real people if they can't even throw their trash in proper places. Maybe there piles left behind in the mountains.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
連垃圾都不知道扔進垃圾桶，算什麼正經人？山裡說不定還堆著他們留下的垃圾呢。

scripts.text: Do you also burn the contaminated materials?
scripts.translation: 受汙染的材料也在這裡焚燒嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
That's not it. I only categorize large materials or technical equipment.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
不是。我只負責分類大型物資和技術裝置。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
There are separate waste dumps that collect only contaminated materials that can't be burned. We're often in contact with one another.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
不能焚燒的汙染物會送到專門的廢棄物處理場。我們經常和那邊聯絡。

scripts.text: Did you go there yourself?
scripts.translation: 你自己去過那裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
No, I don't actually go there myself. There's a specialized department in charge of that. They use the rails with the wagons because the materials are toxic or too large.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
沒有，我不親自去。那邊有專門的部門負責。材料有毒，或者體積太大，所以他們用軌道和貨車運送。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Huh... you know... the garbage... is an important job...
scripts.translation:
[工人]
嗯...你知道嗎...垃圾處理...也是很重要的工作...

scripts.text: Do you know Patrick Kaufmann?
scripts.translation: 你認識帕特里克·考夫曼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Patrick Kaufmann...? No, but you mean Patrick Young, right?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
帕特里克·考夫曼...？不，你說的是帕特里克·楊吧？

scripts.text: No. But I'm heading to the waste area.
scripts.translation: 不。但我正要去廢棄物區域。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Oh, you're going to the <NAVI>[waste area]<INFO>sp_rudus,227,351,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>? Huh, good luck. I think you'll need it.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
哦，你要去<NAVI>[廢棄物區域]<INFO>sp_rudus,227,351,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>？那祝你好運...我想你會用得上的。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Oh, you're going to the <NAVI>[waste area]<INFO>sp_rudus,227,351,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>? Huh, good luck. I think you'll need it.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
哦，你要去<NAVI>[廢棄物區域]<INFO>sp_rudus,227,351,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>？那祝你好運...我想你會用得上的。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What should I do next? I guess I can't keep working here.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我接下來該怎麼辦？看來我沒法繼續在這裡工作了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How do you find anything in such a big place? There is no one to ask.
Can you really look at the traces of abandoned projects...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這麼大的地方，該怎麼找線索？這裡連個能問的人都沒有。
你真能從廢棄的專案裡找到痕跡嗎...？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's nothing here. I don't know what to look for...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡什麼都沒有。我也不知道該找什麼...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Voices]
The ratio of mixture is 1:3... what are you doing?, it should be 1:4. Do you want the lab to explode?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的說話聲]
混合比例是1比3...你在幹什麼？應該是1比4！想讓實驗室爆炸嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What.... I can hear a <NAVI>[voice]<INFO>sp_rudus,15,280,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, where does it come from?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼...我聽見<NAVI>[一個聲音]<INFO>sp_rudus,15,280,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。是從哪裡傳來的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What.... I can hear a <NAVI>[voice]<INFO>sp_rudus,15,280,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>, where does it come from?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼...我聽見<NAVI>[一個聲音]<INFO>sp_rudus,15,280,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。是從哪裡傳來的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There is nothing here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡什麼都沒有。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
A 1:2 ratio might better... No it's better not to experiment. I think you're right.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
1比2也許更好...不，還是別試了。你說得對。

scripts.text: Oh, woah, hello?? It's ok I don't mind!
scripts.translation: 哦，哇，你好？...沒事，我不介意！

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Why are you surprised? I'm not dead yet.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
你為什麼要驚訝？我還活著呢。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
It's okay. I'd be surprised too if I saw myself. I try not to look in the mirrors.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
沒關係，換作是我，看到自己這副樣子也會嚇一跳。我儘量不照鏡子。

scripts.text: Why do you look like a researcher...?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼看起來像個研究員...

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Why shouldn't a researcher be here?
You want to know why a person who led experiments was thrown out in a dumpster and abandoned.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
研究員為什麼不能待在這裡？
你是想問，為什麼一個主導實驗的人會被扔進垃圾堆裡遺棄吧？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
My only goal is being successful, and I've done all sort of things.
That's a proper ending for me don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
我一心只想成功，為此什麼都做過。你不覺得這算是我的報應嗎？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Research and experimentation are not always safe. I thought I would be okay, but I couldn't avoid it in the end.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
研究和實驗並不總是安全的。我以為自己不會出事，最後還是沒能逃過一劫。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
The person who abandoned me here didn't think I'd still be alive.
Because the lab was crushed, toxic substances sprung up all over the place.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
把我丟在這裡的人沒想到我還活著。
實驗室被壓毀後，有毒物質洩漏得到處都是。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Eheh. So I'm just going to wait here and die like this. I wanted to surprise the would with my research, but I ended up living here instead.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
呵呵，我就待在這裡等死吧。本想用研究震驚世界，結果卻落得在這裡苟活。

scripts.text: Are there any other people here?
scripts.translation: 這裡還有其他人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Why are you looking for? A dead person? A living person? Or perhaps a half dead person?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
你在找什麼？死人？活人？還是半死不活的人？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
How many discarded people do you think you'll find here?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
你覺得這裡能找到多少個被遺棄的人？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
If they had a ^0000FFcertain physical condition and a poor background^000000, sometimes just homeless, it was easier to experiment on them.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
只要他們^0000FF身體狀況特殊、家境貧寒^000000，有時甚至無家可歸，拿來做實驗就更容易了。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Don't look at me like that. The poorer you are, the better off your family is, we would be fools to not take advantage of these people. At least that's what I thought back then.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
別這樣看我。你越窮，家人反而越能過上好日子；不利用這些人，我們才是傻子。至少當時我是這麼想的。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Where do you think all these missing people have gone to over the years?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
你覺得這些年來，所有失蹤的人都去了哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Many of the missing people of Schwarzwald would end up here. Are you going to investigate every single one of them? If you had enough time, it wouldn't be a bad thing.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
修瓦魯茲巴魯德有很多失蹤者最後都被送到這裡。你打算一個個查嗎？有時間的話，倒也不妨查查。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Or are you only looking for one person in particular?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
還是說，你只是在找特定的某一個人？

scripts.text: I'm looking for Patrick Kaufmann.
scripts.translation: 我在找帕特里克·考夫曼。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
When did he come in?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
他是什麼時候來的？

scripts.text: I don't know that.
scripts.translation: 我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Well.. I ^0000FFdon't have the information you seek.^000000 I was the last person to come here.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
嗯...我^0000FF沒有你要找的訊息。^000000我是最後一個被送到這裡的人。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
I don't have much to do, but I've looked through this place and I haven't seen anyone by that that... you know what I mean?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
我沒什麼事做，已經把這裡找遍了，也沒見到你說的那個人...你懂我的意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
You should try and look for an ^0000FFIdentification Bracelet^000000 in the pile of garbage. DO you know what it is?
The wrist band is a bracelet. The names of the specimens are written on it.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
你可以在垃圾堆裡找找^0000FF身份識別手鐲^000000。知道那是什麼嗎？那是戴在手腕上的手環，上面寫著實驗體的名字。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
If he did, there would be a bracelet somewhere on the floor. It might not even be there anymore...
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
如果他有手鐲，地上應該會留著一個。不過現在可能已經找不到了...

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
If you can't find him, you can probably just buy a bracelet at a market and have a proper burial instead.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
如果找不到他，或許可以去市場買個手鐲，至少給他辦場像樣的葬禮。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
... why am I not going? I did everything I wanted to do here.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
...我為什麼還不走？想做的事明明都做完了。

scripts.text: We're going out together.
scripts.translation: 我們一起離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Leaving this place? Don't, I'm dying. It's the gruesome truth. I know my body well. It's what I studied.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
離開這裡？別費心了，我快死了。這就是殘酷的事實。我很瞭解自己的身體，畢竟我研究的就是這個。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
For now, my foot is like this, but the other leg will change soon.
Then both of my arms... and at the end... can you still call me humans?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
現在只有一隻腳變成這樣，但另一條腿很快也會變。接著是雙臂...最後...你還會把我當人看嗎？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Even if I received treatments, there's no chance I'd survive. I know this well. Wouldn't it be best for me to have a quiet life here without anyone?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
就算接受治療，我也活不了。我很清楚。與其被人打擾，不如獨自在這裡安靜度過餘生，不是更好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
See, this is my family now. Why do I have to carry such a heavy load? It's a hundred times easier to give up hope than to be alive elsewhere isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
你看，這裡就是我的家。揹負這麼沉重的希望又有什麼意義？放棄希望，可比在別處多苟活一會兒輕鬆一百倍，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Do I sound weird when I say stuff like that? I think I'm losing it a little.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
我這麼說是不是很奇怪？我覺得自己快撐不住了。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Yes, sometimes I even dream of taking people out of their misery.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
是啊，有時候我甚至會想，幫那些人結束痛苦。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
It's not probably what their family would have wanted, but it's dangerous outside for them. You know what I mean?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
他們的家人或許不希望這樣，可外面對他們來說太危險了。你懂我的意思吧？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
And... I don't think it's a coincidence.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
而且...我覺得這不是巧合。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
If you come back here after a while and I'm completely turned into a monster, please kill me.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
如果你過些日子回來，發現我已經徹底變成魔物，就殺了我吧。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
I would have rather have my life cut off short than living just a second as a monster. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
我寧願就此死去，也不願哪怕多一秒以魔物的樣子活著。明白嗎？

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
Huh. Surprisingly, I told you a lot. I should rest.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
呵，沒想到我說了這麼多。我得休息了。

scripts.text:
[Discarded Person]
You should try and look for an ^0000FFIdentification Bracelet^000000 in the pile of garbage. Do you know what it is?
The wrist band is a bracelet. And that is where the names of the specimens are written.
scripts.translation:
[被遺棄者]
去垃圾堆裡找找^0000FF身份識別手鐲^000000吧。知道那是什麼嗎？那是戴在手腕上的手環，上面寫著實驗體的名字。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I looked through the garbage and found several identification bracelet. Let's look elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我翻了翻垃圾，找到幾個身份識別手鐲。去別處看看吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think there's anything here related to Kaufmann.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡好像沒有和考夫曼有關的東西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I looked through the pile, I found nothing but garbage.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我翻遍了那堆東西，除了垃圾什麼也沒找到。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I digged a bracelet buried in a pile of garbage. This seems to be an identification bracelet from the experiments. It says... Pat... Patrick... Kauf...man.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我從垃圾堆裡挖出一隻手鐲，應該是實驗用的身份識別手鐲。上面寫著...帕特...帕特里克...考夫...曼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is Patrick Kaufmann's bracelet... let's go back to <NAVI>[Kaya]<INFO>sp_cor,136,146,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是帕特里克·考夫曼的手鐲...回去找<NAVI>[卡雅]<INFO>sp_cor,136,146,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I looked through the pile, there was nothing there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我翻遍了那堆東西，那裡什麼都沒有。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've already seen this place. Let's look elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個地方已經找過了。去別處看看吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This place seems like a dead end.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡似乎走不通。

scripts.text:
[Est]
Oh you're here. I heard that the recon team has taken control over the railroad transport route.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
哦，你來了。我聽說偵察隊已經控制了鐵路運輸線。

scripts.text: Ask about the next operation.
scripts.translation: 詢問下一步行動

scripts.text:
[Est]
We took control of the transport route, but they'll probably fight back in a few hours. Then, it would make the operation useless.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我們雖然控制了運輸線，但他們大概幾小時後就會反撲。到時候這次行動就白費了。

scripts.text:
[Est]
We are planning to carry out an all-out battle on the surrounding area to prevent a counterattack. Of course the civilians won't be included...
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我們打算在周邊地區展開全面作戰，防止敵人反擊。當然，會讓平民撤離...

scripts.text: Ask what you need to prepare.
scripts.translation: 詢問需要準備什麼

scripts.text:
[Est]
The briefing will be held after we enter the operational area. Make sure you bring the supplies you need.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
進入行動區域後會進行簡報。記得帶齊所需補給。

scripts.text:
[Est]
We've taken control of the route, they'll probably fight back in a few hours.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
我們控制了路線，他們大概幾個小時後就會反擊。

scripts.text: ^FF0000Please note that, any abnormal monster handling inside the instance such as taming is not considered normal and may hinder the instance progress.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000請注意，在副本中馴服魔物等異常行為不屬於正常操作，可能會妨礙副本進度。^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000In beginners mode, the player transform into a monster. Please not that existing transformation effect will disappear after entering and proceeding.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000初學者模式下，玩家會變身為魔物。進入副本並繼續後，已有的變身效果會消失。^000000

scripts.text:
[Est]
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Est]
Are you alone? It's difficult if you're alone. Form a party, make a unit, and start.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
你是一個人嗎？獨自行動會很困難。組隊並編成小隊後再開始吧。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Est]
Inspect your unit before we enter for the occupation.
scripts.translation:
[埃斯特]
進入佔領區域前，先檢查一下小隊情況。

scripts.text: The preparation for the operation is not yet complete or your party is performing another operation.
scripts.translation: 行動準備尚未完成，或你的隊伍正在執行其他行動。

scripts.text: ^FF0000Please note that, any abnormal monster handling inside the instance such as taming is not considered normal and may hinder the instance progress.^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000請注意，在副本中馴服魔物等異常行為不屬於正常操作，可能會妨礙副本進度。^000000

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
It's not time for the operation yet, just rest for now.
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
現在還不是行動時間，先休息一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
Even though we suppressed the enemy from the first annihilation operation, the mutants started crawling out again.
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
第一次殲滅行動雖然壓制了敵人，但變異體又開始不斷湧出來了。

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
It will be easier if we can destroy the source. But those on the top won't approve it, so we'll have to begin a secondary search.
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
要是能摧毀源頭就好了。但上級不會批准，我們只能開始第二輪搜尋。

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
I hope the search will be completed safely.
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
希望搜尋一切順利，大家都能平安回來。

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
Are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
你準備好了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
Are you alone? It's difficult if you're alone. Form a party, make a unit, and start.
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
你是一個人嗎？獨自行動會很困難。組隊並編成小隊後再開始吧。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Operation Officer]
Perform a last unit check before the search.
scripts.translation:
[作戰官]
搜尋開始前，最後檢查一下小隊。

scripts.text: The preparation for the operation is not yet complete or your party is performing another operation.
scripts.translation: 行動準備尚未完成，或你的隊伍正在執行其他行動。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Ah, Adventurer! Long time, no see! Didn't you miss me?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
啊，冒險者！好久不見！你沒想我嗎？

scripts.text: Do you know me?
scripts.translation: 你認識我嗎？

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 沒有...

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Ah, you're so cold, Adventurer. Don't be like that.
I'm on watch duty here, to keep strangers away.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
啊，你可真冷淡，冒險者。別這樣嘛。
我在這裡值守，負責攔住陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
But since you're not a stranger, I'll let you pass.
You've got weapons and armor that match your class, and you're wearing warm clothes. Pass!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
不過你不是陌生人，我就放你過去。武器和防具都符合你的職業，還穿得夠暖和。可以通過！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Mina said you can come back later. It's too early for his lovely children to be up and about.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
米娜說你可以晚點再來。現在還太早，她那些可愛的孩子們還沒起床活動呢。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
... The security devices and traps that summon monsters are still in low power mode. Leave them alone, or they can get easily overheated.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
...召喚魔物的安保裝置和陷阱還處於低功耗模式。別碰它們，否則很容易過熱。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Please come back after dawn when Mina's children wake up and get ready for another energetic day!
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
等天亮、米娜的孩子們醒來，準備好迎接新一天後再回來吧！

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
They'll be fully charged after dawn, and ready to operate again. Come back, then.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
天亮後它們就會充滿電，恢復運作。到時候再回來。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Oh, Adventurer! Long time, no see! Actually, I'd like to ask you something. It's about Mina.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
哦，冒險者！好久不見！我有件事想問你，是關於米娜的。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Just let me explain. When you came after me, my machines that used to protect me--
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
聽我解釋。你來追我的時候，那些保護我的機器——

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
No, we didn't catch Mina's machines. They've been in hiding, sleeping.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
不，我們沒抓到米娜的機器。它們一直藏著，處於休眠狀態。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
It's Elyumina's! Elyumina's machines! And traps! ... They go stealth in low power mode in case of emergency. And it's time that they show back up and start rampaging again.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
那是我的機器！艾露米娜的機器！還有陷阱！...它們遇到緊急情況時會進入低功耗隱匿模式。現在它們要重新現身，再次大鬧一場了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Well, the problem is, Mina--
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
嗯，問題是，米娜——

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
It's Elyumina, and I can't do it! They're equipped with a high-tech machine learning module.
Since that day, they used data about you, their most powerful enemy, and they've used it to grow rapidly.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
是艾露米娜！而且我控制不了它們！它們裝有高科技機器學習模組。從那天起，它們一直收集你這個最強敵人的資料，飛快地進化。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
I can't control them! ... This is completely unexpected.
The only solution I can think of is to exhaust their batteries until they stop working.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
我控制不了它們！...這完全出乎意料。
我唯一能想到的辦法，就是耗光它們的電池，讓它們停下來。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
And the only person who can do it is you. You beat the EL1_A17T. Of course, I'll go with you, but I'll only be there to collect new data from them.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
只有你能辦到。你打敗過EL1_A17T。我當然也會同行，不過只是去收集它們的新資料。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
I'd love to go too, but Mina won't let me. I wonder if it's because he cares.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
我也很想去，可米娜不讓我去。是不是因為他關心我呢？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Anyway, I don't think you can handle them by yourself.
That hooligan who detained me that day also won't be enough. Come back in a party with other adventurers, will you?
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
總之，我覺得你一個人對付不了它們。
那天扣留我的那個莽漢也不夠。和其他冒險者組隊再回來，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Then, we've at least got four, including me and Mina--
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
那麼，至少我們得有四個，包括我和米娜——

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
I'll give you more details when we're inside. Please, say yes!
Please! Before he gives me a coronary!
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
進去後我會詳細說明。拜託了，答應吧！
求你了！別讓他把我氣出心臟病！

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
It's time Mina's children are up and about, Adventurer.
Do you want to play with them and tuck them back into bed while everyone else waits for you to finish?
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
冒險者，米娜的孩子們該起床活動了。要不要陪它們玩玩，等大家忙完再把它們哄回床上？

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
... Soon, my security devices and traps will come out of their low power mode and become mobile again.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
...很快，我的安保裝置和陷阱就會退出低功耗模式，重新活動起來。

scripts.text:
[Elyumina]
Do you want to lock down Cor, exhaust them, and collect data again?
Please say yes. Let me follow you. I can't wait to get away from this guy.
scripts.translation:
[艾露米娜]
你想封鎖柯爾，耗光它們的電量，再收集一輪資料嗎？答應吧，讓我跟你去。我真受不了那傢伙了。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Mm, I'm sorry to hear that. Adventurer, if you'd like to join the operation, then as the leader of the party, please select Ready.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
嗯，真遺憾。冒險者，想參加行動的話，請讓隊伍首領選擇“準備”。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
And after the Memorial dungeon is created and all your party members select Enter, you can select Enter to start the operation.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
記憶副本建立後，所有隊員都選擇“進入”，你再選擇“進入”就能開始行動。

scripts.text: ^ff0000Please note that you can't clear this dungeon if you try to tame monsters or perform any other irrelevant monster-related activities.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000請注意：馴服魔物或進行其他無關的魔物相關活動，會導致你無法完成此副本。^000000

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
Mm? Mina doesn't think you can do this alone. Please come back in a party, Adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
嗯？米娜覺得你一個人應付不了。冒險者，請組隊後再來。

scripts.text: Enter
scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
There seems to be a problem. Your request has failed. Please try again later. If the problem persists, please contact the Operation Team.
scripts.translation:
[反叛者]
好像出了點問題，申請失敗了。請稍後再試。如果問題仍未解決，請聯絡運營團隊。

scripts.text:
[Rebellion]
